blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Office of the Ombudsman on Saturday said it has initiated a preliminary investigation against Cagayan Rep. Joseph Lasam Lara and members of his family over alleged financial interests in construction companies that bagged billions worth of government contracts. In a statement, the Ombudsman said Lara is being probed for possible plunder under Republic Act No. 7080 and alleged violation of Section 3(h) of RA 3019 or the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act.
